label: Performance Setting
description: Where music happens, from the concert platform to the practice room. Composes with location/nightlife, which owns the venues people drink in.

items.name: concert-platform
items.text: a concert platform under house lights, chairs and stands laid out in an arc, an audience just visible past the edge

items.name: orchestra-pit
items.text: an orchestra pit sunk below the stage lip, players lit only by stand lamps, the score the brightest thing in the frame
items.text_short: orchestra pit lit only by stand lamps

items.name: recording-booth
items.text: a vocal booth behind glass, a large-diaphragm microphone on a shock mount, foam wedges and a headphone cable looping down
items.text_short: vocal booth behind glass, mic on a shock mount

items.name: control-room
items.text: a studio control room with a large-format desk, monitors on stands and the live room visible through the glass beyond
items.text_short: control room desk, live room through the glass

items.name: rehearsal-room
items.text: a rehearsal room with carpet on the walls, mismatched chairs and a kit that never leaves, cases stacked in the corner
items.text_short: rehearsal room with carpet on the walls

items.name: practice-room
items.text: a bare practice room with one chair, a stand and a mirror, a clock deliberately placed out of eye line
items.text_short: bare practice room, one chair and a mirror

items.name: club-stage
items.text: a small club stage barely raised above the floor, the crowd close enough to touch the monitors, a low ceiling holding the sound in
items.text_short: small club stage, crowd on the monitors

items.name: festival-mainstage
items.text: a festival main stage in full daylight, scaffolding and screens either side, the front barrier packed and the field running back for ever
items.text_short: festival main stage in full daylight

items.name: street-corner
items.text: a street corner pitch with good reflections off the shopfronts, a case open on the flagstones and a shifting audience
items.text_short: street corner pitch with good reflections

items.name: church-loft
items.text: a church organ loft above the nave, console tucked behind the pipe case, a mirror angled to see the altar
items.text_short: organ loft above the nave, mirror to the altar

items.name: bedroom-setup
items.text: a bedroom setup on a desk, an interface and a microphone on a boom, a duvet pinned to the wall behind for deadening
items.text_short: bedroom setup, duvet pinned up for deadening

items.name: open-air-bandstand
items.text: a cast-iron bandstand in a park, ornamental roof and deck chairs scattered on the grass at a polite distance
items.text_short: cast-iron bandstand, deck chairs on the grass
